title: Walking the Dog in the Neighborhood Park
description: Các câu giao tiếp tự nhiên khi dắt thú cưng đi dạo và gặp gỡ hàng xóm trong công viên.

coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Always attach the sturdy leash before stepping outside.
Friendly dogs rarely bark at strangers in the park.
Our green neighborhood has many safe walking paths.
